parts.about_es: Preguntas muy sencillas sobre ti: tu nombre, tu edad, dónde vives, tu familia y lo que te gusta. Contesta con una frase completa.

turns.examiner: Now, let's talk about your family. How many people are there in your family?
Have you got any brothers or sisters?
Now, let's talk about your day. What time do you get up?
What do you eat for lunch?
Please tell me something about your house or flat.

useful_language: I am from… / I live in…
There are… people in my family.
I have got one brother. His name is…
I get up at seven o'clock.
My flat is small. It has got…
tips_es: Frases completas: no «seven», sino «I get up at seven o'clock».
Con «Have you got…?» se contesta «Yes, I have» o «No, I haven't», y después se añade algo.
Si no entiendes: «Sorry, can you repeat, please?».

parts.about_es: Ves varios dibujos de un tema y dices si te gusta cada cosa y por qué. Después el examinador te hace unas preguntas. En el examen se hace con un compañero.

turns.examiner: Now, here are some pictures that show different hobbies. Do you like these hobbies? Say why or why not.
Do you think reading is boring? Why?
Which of these hobbies do you like best?
What do you do on Saturdays?

useful_language: I like… because it is fun.
I don't like… because it is boring.
I play football with my friends.
tips_es: De cada dibujo, una frase: «I like swimming because it is fun».
Después de «like», «love» y «hate», el verbo va en -ing: «I like reading».
